_comment: PROSPECTIVE sweep configuration for the planted-error phase diagram. Committed BEFORE the sweep is run. Claim 4 is quoted verbatim from blurring_the_critic.tex lines 563-577 (claim:crossover).

claim4_verbatim.omega_definition: omega := ||grad e||_inf / ||e||_inf   (function sup-norms over the action domain)
claim4_verbatim.prediction: the zeroth-order estimator has the smaller ERROR-INDUCED variance when sigma*omega > sqrt(d)

estimators_verbatim.g_ZO: Sigma^{-1/2} (1/M) sum_i (Q_phi(mu + Sigma^{1/2} u_i) - Qbar) u_i, Qbar = sample mean

wml_operator.form: Delta_mu_WML = sum_i w_i (a_i - mu), w_i = softmax(Q_i / eta)
wml_operator.eta: solved per batch by minimising g(eta) = eta*eps_E + eta*log((1/M) sum_i exp(Q_i/eta)) (standard MPO E-step dual)
wml_operator.note: this is the ACTUAL weighted-MLE mean update, not a generic finite-difference estimator; g_ZO is reported alongside because it is the manuscript's own eq:estimators object

trust_region.source: docs/wasted_step_fraction_proposition.md Sec.1, resolved against blurring_v6 prop:estep

oracle.Q_pi: -0.5 (a - a_star)^T H (a - a_star) with H = I
oracle.a_star: G * v_signal, ||v_signal|| = 1, G = 1.0 fixed for every d so the true signal energy does not change with d
oracle.exact_gradient: grad Q_pi(0) = G * v_signal; because Q_pi is quadratic its Gaussian blur has the SAME gradient, so the oracle is exact, not Monte Carlo

planted_error.primary: e(a) = eps * sin(omega * v_e^T a + phase), ||v_e|| = 1
planted_error.why_single_sinusoid: for J=1 the theorem's sup-norms are attained analytically: ||e||_inf = eps and ||grad e||_inf = eps*omega, so omega is EXACT and independently verifiable rather than assumed
planted_error.secondary: J=4 superposed random directions with sup-norms calibrated numerically (robustness only)

budget.PW: M critic forward passes + M critic backward passes
budget.ZO: M critic forward passes, 0 backward passes
budget.WML: M critic forward passes, 0 backward passes
budget.note: equal M for all three, as in eq:estimators; PW's extra backward passes are an asymmetry in favour of the sampling estimators and are REPORTED, not corrected for

primary_outcome: ratio_e = Var[g_ZO]_e / Var[g_PW]_e, where Var[.]_e is the trace of the covariance of the EXACT error-induced component, isolated by common random numbers: ghat[Q_pi + e] - ghat[Q_pi]. Claim 4 predicts ratio_e < 1 iff r > 1.
secondary_outcomes: trust-region-normalised update MSE against the exact oracle update, per estimator
directional cosine to the oracle gradient
P(WML update error < PW update error)
large-M agreement of both estimators with the blurred gradient (baseline proposition)
falsification: The r=1 boundary is marked before results are inspected. The observed crossover of ratio_e is estimated with uncertainty and reported wherever it lands. No fitting of the crossover to 1.0 is permitted; a crossover away from 1, or absent, is reported as such.
